card.name: News quotes and attribution openers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short words that open a quoted statement or sourced news line, such as an opening quote mark after 'said' or 'From the WSJ:'. It also fires on scattered news-style spots like commas in place names and numbers.

modes.label: Opening quote after attribution
modes.description: A quotation mark or colon that begins a quoted statement after a speaker or outlet is named.
